u0: Initial phase: no fall has occurred yet and no post-fall pickup is pending. Get the box if it is still on the floor, carry it, and head for the exit; reaching the exit while holding the box completes the task. If the box falls, move to u3 and pick it up on the very next move.
u1: First fall has occurred and been recovered: the box is back in hand, with no pending immediate pickup. Continue toward the exit while carrying the box. If a second fall happens, move to u4 and recover the box on the very next move.
u2: Second fall has occurred and been recovered: all fall-recovery obligations in the reward machine are complete. Keep the box in hand and reach the exit; no further fall recovery is required.
u3: First fall has just happened and the box is out of hand: immediate-recovery phase. The very next move must pick the box up again; remaining without it fails into u5. Recovering it away from the exit moves to u1, while reaching the exit holding it succeeds.
u4: Second fall has just happened and the box is out of hand: immediate-recovery phase after the second fall. The very next move must pick it up again; failing to do so leads to failure in u5. Recovering it away from the exit moves to u2, while reaching the exit holding it succeeds.
u5: Failure sink: an immediate pickup after a fall was missed, so the fall-recovery requirement has been violated. No successful progress remains; reaching the exit will not count as task success.
u6: Success terminal: the agent has reached the exit while carrying the box, with all required fall recoveries satisfied. The task is complete and no further action is needed.
